description: 1.0.0v - Initial nationwide AccuWeather scraper, PowerForecast Heat Index & Appliance Energy computation engine with interactive UI and API

targets.commit_message: 1.0.0v - Initial nationwide AccuWeather scraper, PowerForecast Heat Index & Appliance Energy computation engine with interactive UI and API

changes: Targeted scraping for San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan from AccuWeather with Playwright anti-detection and fast TLS engine
Nationwide expansion across all 17 regions of the Philippines (NCR, Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao)
Implemented NOAA / Rothfusz 9-term polynomial Heat Index calculation with Steadman approximation and edge humidity adjustments
Implemented PAGASA / NOAA risk levels and physiological heat stress advisories
Adaptive Inverter HVAC cooling power draw modulation model
24-Hour dynamic load curve forecasting and peak window load-shifting recommendations
Interactive CLI, FastAPI REST API, and Premium Cyber-Dark Glassmorphism Web Dashboard
